buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA-> ------------------------- 1. THE TENDERER SHALL BE A MICRO OR SMALL SCALE INDUSTRY (LSSI) REGISTERED IN THE STATE OF ODISHA AND SHALL HAVE ITS MANUFACTURING UNIT LOCATED IN THE STATE OF ODISHA. THE TENDERER SHALL SUBMIT A NOTARIZED COPY OF A VALID SSI/DIC/NSIC/UDYAM REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OR ANY OTHER RELEVANT REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE IN SUPPORT OF THE ABOVE REQUIREMENT ALONG WITH THE OFFER. 2. THE TENDERER SHALL HAVE SUCCESSFULLY SUPPLIED AT LEAST 1,00,000 PAIRS OF CANVAS/CHROME LEATHER HAND GLOVES IN ANY ONE OF THE LAST SEVEN (07) YEARS PRECEDING THE TENDER OPENING DATE TO ANY CENTRAL GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATION, STATE GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATION, PSU OR PUBLIC LISTED COMPANY. THE TENDERER SHALL SUBMIT COPIES OF RELEVANT PURCHASE ORDERS/CONTRACTS ALONG WITH CORRESPONDING DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF EXECUTION, SUCH AS CRAC, GARN, TAX INVOICES, COMPLETION CERTIFICATES OR OTHER ACCEPTABLE DOCUMENTS, ESTABLISHING SUCCESSFUL SUPPLY OF THE REQUIRED QUANTITY IN ANY ONE OF THE ELIGIBLE YEARS. 3. IN CASE THE TENDERER HAS EARLIER SUPPLIED THE SUBJECT MATERIAL TO ROURKELA STEEL PLANT (RSP), THE TENDERER SHALL FURNISH THE RELEVANT

PURCHASE ORDER (PO) NUMBER(S) AND GARN NUMBER(S) ALONG WITH THE OFFER. NO OTHER DOCUMENTS REQUIRED IN TTHIS REGARD. REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION-> -------------------- RATE CONTRACT OF GLOVE, CHROME LEATHER/CANVAS, 12 INCH FOR 2026-28. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS-> -------------------- 1. THIS PROCUREMENT IS FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF A TWO (02) YEAR RATE CONTRACT FOR SUPPLY OF GLOVE, CHROME LEATHER/CANVAS, 12 INCH. THE E STIMATED REQUIREMENT IS 1,20,000 PAIRS PER YEAR, I.E., 2,40,000 PAIRS DURING THE INITIAL RATE CON TRACT PERIOD OF TWO YEARS. 2. RSP RESERVES THE RIGHT TO EXTEND THE VALIDITY OF THE RATE CONTRACT FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF ONE (01) YEAR ON THE SAME TERMS, CONDITIONS AND RATES, SUBJECT TO SATISFACTORY PERFORMANCE OF THE CONTRACTOR AND MUTUAL ACCEPTANCE. 3. THE SUCCESSFUL TENDERER SHALL SUPPLY THE MATERIAL AS AND WHEN RELEASE ORDERS ARE PLACED DURING THE VALIDITY OF THE RATE CONTRACT. 4. ONE (01) PAIR OF SAMPLE SHALL BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE OFFER FOR EXAMINATION AND EVALUATION OF QUALITY BY RSP. OFFERS RECEIVED WITHOUT SAMPLE MAY BE LIABLE FOR REJECTION. ELIGIBLE LOCAL SSI BIDDERS MAY BE ALLOWED TO SUBMIT THE REQUIRED SAMPLES WITHIN 7 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF OPENING OF THE TEN DER. sample shall be submitted at Dy Mgr (MM SC K S Samantaray , Centarl store, Rourkela Steel Plant, Mob : 8 895504615 5. THE BULK SUPPLY SHALL STRICTLY CONFORM TO THE APPROVED SAMPLE IN ALL

RESPECTS. ANY DEVIATION MAY LEAD TO REJECTION OF THE MATERIAL. 6. ALL MATERIAL SHALL BE SUPPLIED FROM FRESH MANUFACTURE ONLY. OLD STOCK OR DETERIORATED MATERIAL SHALL NOT BE ACCEPTED. 7. THE MANUFACTURER'S NAME, MONTH & YEAR OF MANUFACTURE SHALL BE CLEARLY AND LEGIBLY MARKED ON EACH PAIR OF GLOVES OR ITS PACKING, AS APPLICABLE. 8. THE GLOVES SHALL BE FREE FROM ANY DEFECTS AND SHALL NOT CAUSE ANY IRRITATION, ALLERGIC REACTION OR DISCOMFORT TO HUMAN SKIN DURING NORMAL USE. 9. RSP RESERVES THE RIGHT TO INCREASE OR DECREASE THE TOTAL ORDERED QUANTITY BY UP TO 25% DURING THE VALIDITY OF THE RATE CONTRACT AT THE SAME RATES, TERMS AND CONDITIONS. 10. DELIVERY SHALL BE MADE AGAINST RELEASE ORDERS ISSUED FROM TIME TO TIME DURING THE VALIDITY OF THE RATE CONTRACT. THE QUANTITY INDICATED IS TENTATIVE AND DOES NOT GUARANTEE PROCUREMENT OF THE ENTIRE ESTIMATED QUANTITY. 11. THE MATERIAL SHALL BE NEW, UNUSED, OF UNIFORM QUALITY, FREE FROM MANUFACTURING DEFECTS AND SHALL FULLY CONFORM TO THE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION AND APPROVED SAMPLE. 12. PACKING SHALL BE ADEQUATE TO PREVENT DAMAGE DURING TRANSIT, HANDLING AND STORAGE. ANY DAMAGE ATTRIBUTABLE TO INADEQUATE PACKING SHALL BE TO THE SUPPLIER'S ACCOUNT. 13. PACKING SHALL BE IN BUNDLES OF 10 PAIRS EACH. 14. THE RATE CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED TO A MINIMUM OF TWO SOURCES, SUBJECT TO THE AVAILABILITY OF TECHNO-COMMERCIALLY ACCEPTABLE OFFERS. THE ESTIMATED MONTHLY REQUIREMENT OF APPROXIMATELY 10,000 PAIRS SHALL BE APPORTIONED BETWEEN THE TWO SUPPLIERS IN THE APPLICABLE RATIO AS PER THE

PREVAILING SAIL/RSP PROCUREMENT POLICY. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT -------------------- 1. THE ESTIMATED MONTHLY REQUIREMENT IS APPROXIMATELY 10,000 PAIRS. THE MATERIAL SHALL BE SUPPLIED AGAINST RELEASE ORDERS ISSUED FROM TIME TO TIME DURING THE VALIDITY OF THE RATE CONTRACT. 2.THE SUPPLIER MAY BE REQUIRED TO DELIVER AT LEAST ONE MONTH'S REQUIREMENT, I.E., 10,000 PAIRS, WITHIN 10 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF RECEIPT OF INFORMATION/RELEASE ORDER FROM RSP. 3. AS THE RATE CONTRACT IS PROPOSED TO BE PLACED ON TWO SOURCES, THE MONTHLY REQUIREMENT SHALL BE APPORTIONED BETWEEN THE SUCCESSFUL SUPPLIERS IN THE APPLICABLE RATIO AS PER THE PREVAILING SAIL/RSP PROCUREMENT POLICY AND COMPANY GUIDELINES. GUARANTEE CLAUSE-> -------------------- 1.THE MATERIAL SHALL BE COVERED UNDER RSP'S STANDARD GUARANTEE CLAUSE. 2.THE MATERIAL SHALL BE GUARANTEED FOR A PERIOD OF 18 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY OR 12 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF COMMISSIONING/USE, WHICHEVER IS EARLIER, AGAINST ANY DEFECT IN DESIGN, MATERIAL, WORKMANSHIP OR MANUFACTURING. 3.THE SUPPLIER SHALL SUBMIT THE GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE (GC) ALONG WITH

EACH LOT/CONSIGNMENT, CERTIFYING THAT THE MATERIAL SUPPLIED IS NEW, FREE FROM MANUFACTURING DEFECTS, AND CONFORMS TO THE PURCHASE ORDER SPECIFICATIONS AS WELL AS THE APPROVED SAMPLE. PACKAGING CLAUSE-> -------------------- 1. THE MATERIAL SHALL BE PROPERLY PACKED TO PREVENT DAMAGE DURING HANDLING, TRANSPORTATION AND STORAGE. PACKING SHALL BE IN BUNDLES OF 10 PAIRS EACH. 2. THE SUPPLIER'S NAME, PURCHASE ORDER NO., MATERIAL DESCRIPTION, UCS CODE, LOT NO./BATCH NO., MONTH & YEAR OF MANUFACTURE, QUANTITY, AND A/T NO. SHALL BE CLEARLY TAGGED OR LEGIBLY MARKED ON EACH PACKAGE/BUNDLE FOR EASY IDENTIFICATION AND TRACEABILITY. INSPECTION AGENCY-> -------------------- INSPECTION SHALL BE CARRIED OUT BY THE INSPECTION AGENCY OF SAIL, ROURKELA STEEL PLANT, BASED ON THE APPROVED SAMPLE AND THE GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE (GC) SUBMITTED FOR EACH LOT. INSPECTION TERM-> ___________________________ 1. INSPECTION SHALL BE CARRIED OUT AT ROURKELA STEEL PLANT (RSP) AFTER RECEIPT OF THE MATERIAL ON THE BASIS OF GC AND APPROVED SAMPLE. 2. THE MATERIAL SHALL BE INSPECTED FOR CONFORMITY TO THE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION, APPROVED SAMPLE, WORKMANSHIP, DIMENSIONS, MARKING,

PACKING AND OVERALL QUALITY. 3. THE BULK SUPPLY SHALL STRICTLY CONFORM TO THE SAMPLE APPROVED BY RSP DURING TENDER EVALUATION. ANY DEVIATION SHALL RENDER THE MATERIAL LIABLE FOR REJECTION. 4. RSP RESERVES THE RIGHT TO DRAW RANDOM SAMPLES FROM ANY CONSIGNMENT AND SUBJECT THEM TO VISUAL, DIMENSIONAL AND PERFORMANCE EXAMINATION, IF REQUIRED. 5. THE DECISION OF RSP'S INSPECTING AUTHORITY REGARDING ACCEPTANCE OR REJECTION OF THE MATERIAL SHALL BE FINAL AND BINDING ON THE SUPPLIER. 6. ANY MATERIAL FOUND DEFECTIVE, NOT CONFORMING TO THE SPECIFICATION, OR DIFFERING FROM THE APPROVED SAMPLE SHALL BE REJECTED AND SHALL BE REPLACED BY THE SUPPLIER AT THEIR OWN COST AND RISK, WITHOUT ANY FINANCIAL IMPLICATION TO RSP. PLACE OF INSPECTION-> ___________________________ AT RSP STORES AFTER RECEIPT. BIDDERS TO NOTE: 1. Bidder must submit filled Annexure-A, Annexure -B (Format for undertaking by the bidder) & Annexure-S (details of supporting documents for verification), along with the offer. Formats attached in the biddocument. 2. The offers of bidder(s) whose performance in SAIL-Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP) have been found to be unsatisfactory may not be considered and SAIL-RSP reserves the right to summarily reject such offers during any stage of tender, including and after price discovery. 3. In case any adverse report is received against a tenderer, as an information or upon enquiry made by SAIL, in respect to capabilities and

performance of the tenderer, after receipt of the tender (even after opening of price bid), the quotation/ tender submitted by such tenderer will be liable to be rejected on the grounds of the adverse report(s) received. 4.i) SAIL reserves the right to verify any supporting document(s) submitted by a participating tenderer /bidder from its source (document issuing authority). ii)In the interest of expeditious completion of verification, a participating tenderer /bidder shall provide a list of each supporting document on its letter head as per "Annexure -S", along with the contract details (Postal address, e mail address, landline /Mobile number) of the issuing authority of each supporting document for verification. iii) Non verification of any supporting document or information, at the sole discretion of SAIL, does not absolve the tenderer / bidder of its absolute responsibility to provide only genuine document(s) in support of eligibility conditions. iv) In case a supporting document or information is found to be fake/forged /tampered/non genuine at any stage during tendering process & even after placement of purchase order /Work order, the tenderer /bidder is liable for punitive actions as per extant guidelines of SAIL. 5. Other terms i. NO DEVIATIONS ARE ACCEPTABLE. By submitting offer against this bid, the bidder is accepting all terms & conditions of the bid as well as GeM terms & conditions. ii. All prices quoted in GeM will be on landed cost basis, inclusive of GST and all taxes/ duties(unless otherwise specified in Special Terms of ATC). iii. Bidders are requested to update the firm’s GST registration status prior to participating in the bid. Since all prices to be quoted in GeM are on landed cost basis, inclusive of GST and all taxes/ duties, the case will be evaluated accordingly. iv. Only relevant document(s) are to be uploaded for technical and commercial scrutiny. Submission of additional documents beyond the requirement will not be taken cognizance of. By participating in the bid, the Bidder agrees to comply with all terms and conditions without

making any alterations, additions, or modifications. Any attempt by the Bidder to include additional terms or clauses in the bid document may result in the bid being rejected by the Buyer at any stage of the evaluation process. The Buyer reserves the right to take appropriate action, including but not limited to disqualification of the Bidder, cancellation of the bid and cancellation of order, at its sole discretion. v. Bidders to compulsorily submit the duly-filled Annexures with stamp and signature of authorized representative, as part of online offer. vi. Any technical query/ clarification, is to be routed through the pre-bid representation functionality available against this bid. vii. Risk purchase (RPN) clause: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, if the Supplier neglects or fails to perform the Agreement by the time or times agreed upon, for any reason other than Force Majeure, the Purchaser after having come to know of such negligence or non-performance, after giving 14 to 30 days notice or any such extended period that the Supplier and Purchaser may mutually agree, to the Supplier to rectify, shall take such action as it considers fit including but not limited to taking risk purchase action for supply of the material, mitigating any losses, at the risk and cost of the Supplier as far as the undelivered quantity in that Delivery Period is concerned. The Right of the Purchaser for Risk Purchase Action is in addition to the Right of Purchaser to terminate the Contract due to the fault of the Supplier. The price differential in case of higher cost to SAIL, if any, shall have to be borne by the defaulting Supplier. Moreover, the defaulting Supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. viii. Before dispatching the material, seller(s) must ensure the following:- a. GeM contract is duly accepted. b. GeM fees has been paid (if any, for contract acceptance) c. GeM contract should remain valid till receipt of material at consignee location. d. Invoices have been created in GeM, confirming dispatch of material ix. SAIL-RSP will be placing back-up order against GeM contract(s) on successful bidder(s). SAIL-RSP’s back-up purchase order, however, will

be released only after acceptance of contract by seller in GeM. The concerned bidder has to mention the back-up order number in the invoices for proper accounting of material upon receipt in RSP. x. Further, non-compliance of the requisites in “viii”&“ix", shall be at the risk of the vendor and any delay(s) arising out of such non-compliance, shall be on vendor's account. . 5.
